scope: Actual Node gateway function, actual isolated Go coordinator process, production browser protocol decoder, independent Ed25519/P-256 signatures, and verified HTTPS with an ephemeral test CA. Platform client-IP headers are synthetic fixtures. No public deployment, native app, desktop pixels, remote input, or TURN forwarding.
checks: Compiled current Go source and started the real coordinator with isolated state and certificate-verified HTTPS
The real backend rejects missing/wrong gateway credentials and malformed asserted client identity
Current production discovery passes the gateway capability policy and returns byte-identical real coordinator JSON
Raw UTF-8/whitespace body bytes survive forwarding; Ed25519 proof binds the public viewer origin, registers a permanent PC ID, rejects replay, and preserves host bearer authorization
Untrusted incoming gateway/client/forwarding headers cannot replace the publisher token or platform client identity
The gateway preserves raw duplicate JSON so the production Go decoder rejects it instead of silently normalizing it
Unchanged browser Coordinator authenticates with real P-256 challenge/proof and its forwarded bearer authorizes device lookup
Real host activation, six-digit PIN redemption, owner approval, bearer-authenticated SDP signaling, session end and deactivation traverse the gateway; this is protocol-only evidence
Ten registration challenges exhaust only client A; spoofed ordinary forwarding headers cannot reset it, while independent client B still obtains a challenge behind the same gateway
The general sensitive-auth bucket also isolates independently asserted clients instead of collapsing all gateway traffic into the upstream socket IP
